infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Adityam Niramayaa uses your camera to scan medicine bills, doctor prescriptions, and pharmacy QR codes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Adityam Niramayaa requires access to your photo library to let you upload doctor prescriptions and lab reports.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Adityam Niramayaa uses your location to show nearby empanelled hospitals, diagnostic centers, and clinics.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Adityam Niramayaa to access your camera to scan medicine bills, doctor slips, and pharmacy QR codes.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Adityam Niramayaa to access your photos to upload doctor prescriptions and health reports.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Adityam Niramayaa to access your location to find nearby hospitals and diagnostic centers.
